question: Consider 6 points located at $P_0=(0,0)$, $P_1=(0,4)$, $P_2=(4,0)$, $P_3=(-2,-2)$, $P_4=(3,3)$ and $P_5=(5,5)$. Let $R$ be the region consisting of all points in the plane whose distance from $P_0$ is smaller than that from any other $P_i$, $i=1,2,3,4,5$. Find the perimeter of the region $R$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
